item.title: My email to Datawind, the company behind the Aakash Ubislate tablet
item.description:
I prebooked an Aakash Ubislate tablet on its first day of availability. Two months later, I’m still waiting, and the email chain with Datawind’s support team tells the whole story.

The booking confirmation

Dear Shafiq,

Your Booking ID is : xxxxxxxxx

Someone from our sales team would get in touch with you and provide you with the payment and delivery options.

The commercial version of the UbiSlate would be launched in early weeks of December.

item.title: Cover Design for ASTRA College Magazine
item.description:
I was asked to put together a cover for ASTRA, the college magazine. The brief was loose enough that I could experiment with typography and layout without worrying too much about brand guidelines or committee sign-off.

The main challenge was making the masthead work at different scales. College magazines tend to be printed cheaply on decent paper, so the design needed to hold up even when the press wasn’t perfect. I kept the palette simple and let the type carry the weight.
